summary: Rework of task 9.4 closing the test-quality reviewer's findings. No production behaviour was changed; the accepted implementation (Plugin.UpdateConfiguration request + plugin-owned IConfigurationReconciliationTrigger boundary + hosted ConfigurationReconciliationTrigger over LibraryReconciliationService) is untouched, and the ArrTagsServiceRegistrator diff is byte-identical to attempt 1. TQ-1 (HIGH): tests/ArrTags.Tests/ConfigurationReconciliationTriggerTests.cs now has RegistratorRegistersThePostSaveTriggerAsAHostedService, which supplies the host-free boundaries the registrator's hosted services resolve (FakeLibraryEventSource, ReconciliationLibraryResolver, FakeMediaLibraryEnumerator, PipelineArtworkHost, and two local throwing stubs for IArtworkLifecycleCoordinator/IArtworkRecoveryGate), calls ArrTagsServiceRegistrator.RegisterServices, builds the provider, resolves IEnumerable<IHostedService>, and asserts Assert.Single(hosted.OfType<ConfigurationReconciliationTrigger>()) plus Assert.Same between the hosted instance and both provider.GetRequiredService<IConfigurationReconciliationTrigger>() and provider.GetRequiredService<ConfigurationReconciliationTrigger>() (proving the hosted service is the same singleton the save path resolves), and asserts the resolved IWorkHintSink count is 0 (nothing started). The assertion is proven non-vacuous: temporarily commenting out the serviceCollection.AddHostedService(...ConfigurationReconciliationTrigger...) registration made the test fail with Assert.Single() 'The collection was empty' (only that test failed), and the registration was then restored. TQ-7: the overstating RegistratorWiresThePostSaveTriggerWithoutStartupWork test (which only checked ImplementationInstance is not null) was replaced by that genuine hosted-registration test. TQ-2 (MEDIUM): new StopAsyncIsBoundedWhenTheReconciliationIsBlocked starts the trigger with a blocked enumerator, asserts StopAsync returns within a bounded wait and under 4s via a Stopwatch (the harness configures a 2s bounded shutdown), then releases the enumerator and asserts via a bounded stability poll that no hint is enqueued (the loop observes cancellation). TQ-3: new ValidButUnactivatedSaveRequestsNoReconciliation uses SaveHarness(registerSnapshotService: false) so a valid candidate is persisted but cannot be activated; it asserts LastConfigurationValidationResult.IsValid is true and trigger.RequestCount == 0. TQ-5: the non-blocking test's vacuous Assert.False(release.IsSet)/Assert.Empty(Hints) were removed; the bounded save-wait is kept as the load-bearing assertion with a clarifying comment, and the reconciler-started signal (entered.Task) is still awaited. TQ-6: the fixed Task.Delay(200) in the coalescing test was replaced by a bounded stability poll (AssertStableAsync) asserting the enumeration count stays 2 for a 300ms window. TQ-4 was not added (optional). TQ-8 (stale 1.0.1.0 matrix counts in docs/limitations.md V6 and docs/release/build-and-release.md) was left unchanged per the out-of-scope instruction; those are release-task owned. Test-file facts increased from 8 to 10; the task 9.4 status text and recorded suite counts in PLANS.md, docs/changelog.md, and docs/project-status.md were updated from 8 facts/Passed 1268/Total 1331/+8 to 10 facts/Passed 1270/Total 1333/+10 so the canonical current-state text stays accurate.
